head: 2e512e0c7817cd66a3ec54ca567fc154ea6c83b2
method: Parent visually inspected all eight contact sheets representing all 96 original screenshots; sheets paste originals without rescaling, but tool display slightly resized sheets. Worker independently decoded all PNGs and checked source-bound raw protocol, geometry and state receipts; those checks are distinct from parent pixel inspection.
scope: Four locales en-XV, mnc-Mong, lzh-Hant, qaa-Zsye-XV; portrait and landscape; JPEG dialog and reachability states.
observations: Endpoint labels and thumb positions agree with expected 1 and 100 states across eight cases.
Dedicated filename views show Untitled.jpg in all eight cases.
Cancel/choose controls appear in their ready views, and returned views show editor.
Initial partial viewport clipping persists; this is bounded reachability acceptance, not simultaneous whole-dialog fit.
No blank or missing-glyph failure observed in these contact sheets.
limits: Screenshots alone do not prove continuous gesture event history or remembered-setting restoration; those rely on separately checked traces and receipts.
No JPEG XL or AVIF endpoint acceptance, API30 acceptance, full native-language linguistic review, accessibility certification or all-control fit claim.
decision: No additional visual blocker found for reviewed PR41 JPEG gesture/reachability scope; retain documented broader layout/localization work.
